ar.title: كمونية اللحم

steps.n1: يقطع اللحم قطعا صغيرة ويحمر في الزيت أو السمن.
steps.n2: يضاف له الثوم المفري حسب مقدار اللحم ثم يضاف الكمون، ويقلب حتى يصفر الثوم.
steps.n3: يضاف مقدار كوب ونصف ماء مع ملعقة الخل والبصلة الصحيحة، ويترك على درجة حرارة هادئة حتى النضج.

en.title: Lamb with Cumin (Kammuniya)
en.intro: This spiced meat dish is a cornerstone of Egyptian home cooking, with cumin providing its distinctive warm, earthy note.

steps.n1: Cut the meat into small pieces and brown it in oil or ghee.
steps.n2: Add the crushed garlic in proportion to the meat, then add the cumin, and stir until the garlic turns golden.
steps.n3: Add a cup and a half of water with the tablespoon of vinegar and the whole onion, and simmer over low heat until cooked through.

legacySteps: Cut the meat into small pieces and brown it in oil or ghee.
Add the crushed garlic in proportion to the meat, then add the cumin, and stir until the garlic turns golden.
Add a cup and a half of water with the tablespoon of vinegar and the whole onion, and simmer over low heat until cooked through.
